record.title: Project Two semantic PaaS v1
record.body: Project Two is the canonical operational subject and is virtualized as a semantic PaaS rather than copied into a second authoritative database. The same admitted Project items can be inspected as memory KV, full-fidelity Project objects, a property graph, bounded graph neighborhoods, relational node/edge/fact tables, RDF-shaped triples, JSON-LD, a service/capability catalog, OCEL-2-shaped process evidence, and bounded adjacency-aware LLM context. ChatGPT uses the bounded request/receipt bus; MCP-capable LLMs use the AshAi junction; humans use the GitHub Project UI. Semantic projections are read-only; graph edges require explicit Project fields or admitted relation-bearing metadata; arbitrary prose remains literal evidence. Live project.services execution is ALIVE. Cross-LLM standing remains PARTIAL_ALIVE until the Ash/MCP exact-head qualification completes.

metadata.virtualization_law: one admitted subject, multiple lawful query surfaces
